name: dev-team-setup
description: /setup-project: interviews you into a spec, designs the system, picks a team of subagents (software, AI/ML, data science), builds it task by task with a visual and your approval at every step, and hands over as-built docs.

owner_name.title: Your name
owner_name.description: How the Orchestrator addresses you in decision cards and result cards.

github_owner.title: GitHub user or org
github_owner.description: Owner for the project repos /setup-project creates (e.g. your GitHub username). Leave empty to try it locally, with no GitHub account.

approval_mode.title: Approval mode
approval_mode.description: every-task = a result card and approval for every task. batch-low-risk = low-risk tasks are approved together in one batch card (high-risk tasks still get their own card).

cost_mode.title: Cost mode
cost_mode.description: quality = models as defined per agent. balanced = Sonnet for reviewer/debugger on low-risk tasks and max 2 debugger rounds.

budget_usd.title: Budget (USD)
budget_usd.description: Spend at which the Orchestrator pauses and asks before going on (0 = no cap). Each result card also shows the task's cost and the total so far.
